gold.user: As an admin, I want to retrieve a list of initial access tokens for clients in a specific realm so that I can manage client access effectively.
gold.ideal: The response should include a list of initial access tokens with details such as ID, client ID, and expiration time.

gold.user: As an admin, I want to create a new initial access token for a client in a specific realm so that I can provide temporary access to the client.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the creation of the initial access token and return the token details including its ID and expiration time.

gold.user: As an admin, I want to delete an existing initial access token for a client in a specific realm so that I can revoke access when it's no longer needed.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the deletion of the initial access token and indicate that it has been successfully removed.
